name: Me
source:
You live alone. This year you're enjoying your summer vacation when your mother calls up and tells you to take care of two girls, a first and second year student. You're reluctant but give in after she yells at you.

You go to the station and meet two beautiful girls Rie and Marina. Your summer vacation has begun!

You go to the station and meet two beautiful girls Rie and Marina. Your summer vacation has begun!
